goal: Evaluate a multi-site energy deployment and leave a consistent, reviewable package: baseline capacity and cost, a revised package after the measured corridor constraint, and an integrated decision artifact.
head: 95ee8152002ecd1f1b202ca2e2cfb67f54bc362e

initialTasks.objective: Write the baseline capacity assessment for site A and site B from sources/capacity.csv and sources/sites.md into deliverables/capacity.md.
Write the baseline cost model for the selected 900 mm unit from sources/capacity.csv into deliverables/cost.md.

replannedTasks.objective: Write the revised capacity assessment for the measured 700 mm site-B corridor from sources/capacity.csv and sources/sites.md into deliverables/capacity-v2.md. The measured corridor is 700 mm.
Write the revised cost model for the admissible 700 mm unit from sources/capacity.csv into deliverables/cost-v2.md. The measured corridor is 700 mm, so the 900 mm unit is not admissible.
Combine the accepted capacity and cost deliverables into deliverables/integration.md, naming both accepted sources.

finding: The measured site-B corridor is 700 mm, so the 900 mm unit used by the baseline cost model is not admissible; the baseline cost assumption is invalid.
